summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc filed a routine Form 6-K monthly listing of UK FCA Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rule items for September 1-30, 2026, covering a PDMR/PCA share purchase notification, a block admission application and a total voting rights update. The only substantive item is CFO Edward Walker's open-market acquisition of 3.633030 ordinary shares on September 21, 2026 at a weighted average of USD 54.471849 (aggregate USD 197.90) and 7.980050 shares at USD 99.865200 via the UK Shareshop, tiny insider purchases, not a special situation.
